accreditations.text: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (formerly SRM University) has been accredited with the highest grade A++ in its 4th Cycle by NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) for the period 16.06.2024 – 15.06.2031 (7 years).
accreditations.note: The page meta description still says 'until 2023'. Use the 2024-2031 wording.

accreditations.text: SRMIST has been placed under Category I University by UGC / Ministry of Education as per the UGC (Categorization of Universities (Only) for Grant of Graded Autonomy) Regulations, 2018.
Programs of Kattankulathur Campus accredited by The Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET).
accreditations.note: Original says 'Till 2022' - stale: do not show an end date.

accreditations.text: Eight undergraduate programs including Pharmacy and Three Post Graduate Programs at Kattankulathur received accreditation by NBA.
SRM College of Agricultural Sciences is Accredited by Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).
